goal:
Show free first paints and happy hour. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §F1, §F2.

SCOPE
- Read get_free_first_paints and get_happy_hour; show 'N free paints left' and mark free cells as 'free' in the stroke total.
- Happy-hour banner: countdown to the next window when closed (Sundays 20:00 UTC, shown in the viewer's local time), time left and free cells left when open; hidden while the first board is still filling.
- Explain the rules in one plain line each: base-price cells only, 100 per person, need to have bought credits once.

ACCEPTANCE
- Tests for the stroke total with free cells, the banner states (filling / closed / open / used up) and local-time display.
- Screenshots at 390 px and desktop.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and the backlog row's new status written in the PR description (the merger updates docs/backlog.md on main; see AGENT.md).
